realm.name: polari-viewer
realm.description: Read-only access to dashboards and class instance tables.

realm.name: polari-admin
realm.description: Full administrative access to the Polari suite — can manage classes, solutions, equations, and users.

realm.name: polari-developer
realm.description: Can create and modify classes, no-code solutions, equations, datasets. Cannot manage users.

realm.name: polari-user
realm.description: Can run and interact with no-code solutions and view dashboards.

clients.name: Polari Backend
clients.description: Confidential OIDC client for the Polari Python backend. Used for token verification and service-to-service calls.

clients.name: Polari Frontend
clients.description: Public OIDC client for the Polari Angular frontend. Standard auth-code flow with PKCE.

clients.name: Polari App Shell
clients.description: Public OIDC client for downloadable native app shells (appstore-1). Standard auth-code flow with PKCE S256; direct grants OFF; custom-scheme callback plus one fixed loopback port (Keycloak has no port wildcards).

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: service_account
clientScopes.description: Specific scope for a client enabled for service accounts

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token
